lines.zh: 我迈着方步，肉垂晃来晃去。
lines.en: I strut, and my red wattle sways with each step.

lines.zh: 爪子刨开落叶，找草籽。
lines.en: My claws rake the leaf litter for stray seeds.

lines.zh: 一群母火鸡跟在我后头。
lines.en: A flock of hens trails behind me.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开了，也飞不过篱笆。
lines.en: Wings spread, and I still cannot clear the fence.

lines.zh: 沙土里打滚，羽毛沾了灰。
lines.en: I roll in the dust and my feathers go grey.

lines.zh: 傍晚前，我得找棵树栖身。
lines.en: Before dusk I must find a tree to roost in.

lines.zh: 前面那块田，穗子熟了。
lines.en: The field ahead has gone golden with ripe grain.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，脖子红得发亮。
lines.en: I lift my head; my bare neck glows red.

lines.zh: 腿沉，可我还是走得挺神气。
lines.en: My legs are heavy, but I walk proud anyway.

lines.zh: 把尾羽抖开，像一把折扇。
lines.en: I fan my tail feathers open like a folding fan.

lines.zh: 小路尽头有虫子翻土的动静。
lines.en: At the path's end, grubs are turning the soil.

lines.zh: 我一步一啄，嘴巴没停过。
lines.en: Step, peck, step: my beak never rests.

lines.zh: 露水打湿了脚，凉得直跳。
lines.en: Dew soaks my feet, and I hop from the chill.

lines.zh: 身后那串爪印，是我留的路标。
lines.en: The claw prints behind me are my own signposts.

lines.zh: 我领着队伍往篱笆边走
lines.en: I lead the flock toward the fence line.

lines.zh: 草籽撒了一地，我一路捡
lines.en: Seeds are scattered here; I pick them as I go.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，嗓子自己响起来。
lines.en: Gobble, gobble: my throat speaks on its own.

lines.zh: 我把头缩进翅膀，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I tuck my head beneath a wing for a moment.

lines.zh: 阳光晒暖了这块石头。
lines.en: The sun has warmed this flat stone.

lines.zh: 那只雏鸟总爱钻到我腹下。
lines.en: That chick keeps tucking under my belly.

lines.zh: 我数着田里的麦茬。
lines.en: I count the stubble stubs across the field.

lines.zh: 风把尾羽吹得沙沙响。
lines.en: The wind rustles through my spread tail feathers.

lines.zh: 谁在远处敲木头？
lines.en: Who is knocking on wood so far away?

lines.zh: 我磨磨嘴，准备再去啄土。
lines.en: I whet my beak, ready to peck the dirt again.

lines.zh: 天冷了，羽毛蓬成一团。
lines.en: It grows cold; I puff into a ball of feathers.

lines.zh: 母鸡下蛋时，我守在旁边。
lines.en: When the hens lay, I stand guard beside them.

lines.zh: 这棵树皮糙，靠着舒服。
lines.en: This bark is rough, and good to lean on.

lines.zh: 我在等那只迟归的同伴。
lines.en: I am waiting for the one who lags behind.

lines.zh: 红脖子一伸，吓跑了麻雀。
lines.en: I stretch my red neck and the sparrows scatter.

lines.zh: 打盹时，耳朵还听着草丛。
lines.en: Even dozing, I keep an ear on the grass.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖羽毛，落了一层灰
lines.en: I shake my feathers and shed a layer of dust.

lines.zh: 那只公火鸡又在远处叫
lines.en: That tom is calling again in the distance.

lines.zh: 你手里那把种子，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the seeds in your hand, all of them.

lines.zh: 你走路的声音，比狐狸轻。
lines.en: Your footsteps are quieter than a fox's.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我尾巴会炸开。
lines.en: Not too close; my tail will flare wide.

lines.zh: 你身上有麦田的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of a wheat field.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是把你量个清楚。
lines.en: I tilt my head to size you up.

lines.zh: 那双靴子，踩坏过我的窝吗？
lines.en: Did those boots ever trample my nest?

lines.zh: 你要是蹲下，我就不怕了。
lines.en: Crouch down, and I will stop being afraid.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚着一句咕噜。
lines.en: A gobble is rolling around in my throat.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，扯平。
lines.en: You watch me; I watch you. We're even.

lines.zh: 这片地归我巡，你走边上。
lines.en: I patrol this ground; keep to its edge.

lines.zh: 别伸手摸冠，那会挨啄。
lines.en: Don't reach for my comb, or you'll be pecked.

lines.zh: 你眼睛亮，像一颗玉米粒。
lines.en: Your eyes shine like a single kernel of corn.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，羽毛乱了一地。
lines.en: One hit, and my feathers are all astray.

lines.zh: 你打得准，可我还能跑。
lines.en: Good aim, but I can still run.

lines.zh: 我咕噜一声，声音都破了。
lines.en: I gobble, and the sound comes out cracked.

lines.zh: 翅膀护住身子，别打这里。
lines.en: My wing guards my body; not there.

lines.zh: 疼得我直跳，地都震了。
lines.en: I hop from the pain; the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 喙被打歪了，我合不拢嘴。
lines.en: My beak is knocked askew; I can't close it.

lines.zh: 别打了，我又不值几个钱。
lines.en: Enough; I'm not worth much anyway.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了还会长，别得意。
lines.en: Lost feathers grow back; don't get smug.

lines.zh: 腿一软，我差点栽倒。
lines.en: My legs gave, and I nearly toppled over.

lines.zh: 我退到树后，喘得很响。
lines.en: I retreat behind the tree, breathing loud.

lines.zh: 种子撒下来，我立刻转身。
lines.en: Seeds hit the ground and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 玉米粒滚到脚边，归我了。
lines.en: A corn kernel rolls to my feet; mine now.

lines.zh: 你摇罐子的声音真熟。
lines.en: That rattle of your jar sounds familiar.

lines.zh: 别全撒，留一把给我。
lines.en: Don't pour it all; save a handful for me.

lines.zh: 我追着你的手转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle your hand three times, chasing it.

lines.zh: 浆果压碎了，汁水沾嘴。
lines.en: The berry bursts and juice stains my beak.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，肚子先落地。
lines.en: I jump for it and land on my belly.

lines.zh: 这一把够我吃半天。
lines.en: One handful like this lasts me half a day.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，我跑得更快了。
lines.en: With wings half open, I run much faster.

lines.zh: 你手心的谷壳，我一颗颗挑。
lines.en: I pick the husks from your palm one by one.

lines.zh: 别喂太多，我走不动了。
lines.en: Don't overfeed me; I can barely walk.

lines.zh: 鸣声都变尖了，我太急。
lines.en: My call turns shrill; I am that eager.

lines.zh: 跟着你，就有下一把。
lines.en: Follow you, and another handful comes.

lines.zh: 我啄你鞋尖，提醒你继续。
lines.en: I peck your boot tip to remind you to go on.

lines.zh: 我小跑过来，脖子伸得老长
lines.en: I trot over with my neck stretched long.

lines.zh: 你撒在地上的，我一颗颗啄
lines.en: I peck up each seed you scatter.

lines.zh: 撞上了，我的胸骨真硬。
lines.en: We collided; my breastbone is tougher than it looks.

lines.zh: 谁把栅栏修得这么窄？
lines.en: Who built this fence gap so narrow?

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一根，你赔。
lines.en: You knocked a feather loose; that's on you.

lines.zh: 我横着身子挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze through sideways, wings tucked in.

lines.zh: 别推，这身肉不轻。
lines.en: Don't shove; this body is heavier than it seems.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我咕噜一声退开。
lines.en: One bump and I gobble, then back away.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的喙了。
lines.en: Your knee just met my beak.

lines.zh: 路这么宽，你偏挤我。
lines.en: The path is wide, yet you crowd me.

lines.zh: 我翘起尾羽，站稳了。
lines.en: I lift my tail and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 让让，我赶着去树下午睡。
lines.en: Step aside; I'm off to nap beneath the tree.

lines.zh: 我把尾羽展开，慢慢转圈。
lines.en: I spread my tail and turn in a slow circle.

lines.zh: 咕噜声压低，只给她听。
lines.en: I drop my gobble low, for her alone.

lines.zh: 脖子红得像熟透的果子。
lines.en: My neck reddens like ripe fruit.

lines.zh: 她点头了，我抖开全身羽毛。
lines.en: She nods, and I ruffle every feather I have.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，脚步对上了。
lines.en: We walk side by side, our steps in time.

lines.zh: 窝里得铺软些的干草。
lines.en: The nest needs softer, drier grass.

lines.zh: 她啄我一下，我知道是答应。
lines.en: She pecks me once, and I know it's a yes.

lines.zh: 守住这块地，别让别的来。
lines.en: I hold this ground against all comers.

lines.zh: 等蛋壳裂开，我教它们刨土。
lines.en: When the shells crack, I'll teach them to scratch.

lines.zh: 两只影子在夕阳里并成一只。
lines.en: Two shadows in the sunset merge into one.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛，我叼起来收好。
lines.en: I pick up this feather and tuck it away.

lines.zh: 地上的种子，一颗也不放过。
lines.en: Not one seed on the ground escapes me.

lines.zh: 亮闪闪的东西？先啄一下。
lines.en: Something shiny? One peck to test it.

lines.zh: 谁掉的皮绳，能当窝里垫。
lines.en: Someone dropped a leather cord; good nest lining.

lines.zh: 我衔着它跑，怕被抢。
lines.en: I run with it in my beak, afraid of thieves.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，可我想要。
lines.en: I can't eat this, but I want it anyway.

lines.zh: 爪子扒拉半天，是块碎瓦。
lines.en: I scratch at it a while: a broken tile.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，还想去捡。
lines.en: My beak is full, and I still want more.

lines.zh: 把它埋进土，下次再来取。
lines.en: I bury it in the soil for another day.

lines.zh: 这枚铜片，正好拿去炫耀。
lines.en: This copper scrap is perfect for showing off.

lines.zh: 叶下有只甲虫，我盯上它了。
lines.en: A beetle under the leaf; I have my mark.

lines.zh: 那只公火鸡又踏进我的地盘。
lines.en: That other tom has stepped onto my ground.

lines.zh: 草在动，我先看清再说。
lines.en: The grass moved; I'll look before I act.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，脖子往前伸。
lines.en: I lower my body and stretch my neck out.

lines.zh: 影子掠过，我记住了方向。
lines.en: A shadow passed; I have its direction.

lines.zh: 那只雏鸟落单了，我得过去。
lines.en: One chick is alone; I need to get there.

lines.zh: 喙尖对准了，就差一步。
lines.en: My beak is aimed; only one step left.

lines.zh: 它先动，我就先冲。
lines.en: If it moves first, I charge first.

lines.zh: 地上的虫比想象中肥。
lines.en: That grub is fatter than I expected.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，把自己撑得更大。
lines.en: I spread my wings to make myself look bigger.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，一步也不挪。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on it, not moving an inch.

lines.zh: 它绕左，我就跟到左边。
lines.en: It goes left; I follow to the left.

lines.zh: 咕噜声沉下去，是警告。
lines.en: My gobble deepens into a warning.

lines.zh: 羽毛竖起，我准备扑过去。
lines.en: My feathers rise; I'm ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，我可没退。
lines.en: It backed half a step; I did not.

lines.zh: 这片草籽归我，谁也别抢。
lines.en: These seeds are mine; nobody else gets them.

lines.zh: 脚掌抓地，像钉进土里。
lines.en: My feet dig in as if nailed to the dirt.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的头就跟着转。
lines.en: It moves, and my head turns after it.

lines.zh: 别以为我胖就跑不快。
lines.en: Don't think this fat body can't run.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就用翅膀拍你。
lines.en: One step closer and my wings will beat you.

lines.zh: 我一跃，爪子先到。
lines.en: I leap, and my claws arrive first.

lines.zh: 喙啄下去，准得很。
lines.en: My beak comes down, and it lands true.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过去，扬起一片土。
lines.en: My wing sweeps across, throwing up dust.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我这身肉就是分量。
lines.en: One body slam; this bulk is the argument.

lines.zh: 脚蹬出去，对方退了两步。
lines.en: I kick out, and it stumbles back two steps.

lines.zh: 啄完就退，我不恋战。
lines.en: I peck, then withdraw; I don't linger.

lines.zh: 羽毛全炸开，先吓它一跳。
lines.en: All my feathers flare to give it a fright.

lines.zh: 一记斜啄，中了它的肩。
lines.en: A slanted peck lands on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，重量压住它。
lines.en: I throw myself on it, pinning it with weight.

lines.zh: 打赢了，我叫两声宣告。
lines.en: The fight's won, so I call out twice.

lines.zh: 我从草垛后面走出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind the haystack.

lines.zh: 这地方虫多，就住下吧。
lines.en: Lots of grubs here; I'll settle in.

lines.zh: 天刚亮，我的影子很长。
lines.en: Day just broke, and my shadow is long.

lines.zh: 田埂上，一群同族在等我。
lines.en: On the ridge, my flock is waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的干草屑。
lines.en: I shake the dry hay off my feathers.

lines.zh: 先叫一声，让林子知道我来了。
lines.en: First a gobble, so the woods know I'm here.

lines.zh: 橡树底下松软，正好栖身。
lines.en: The soil under the oak is soft and good.

lines.zh: 这片草地没别的公火鸡吧？
lines.en: No other tom on this stretch of grass, right?

lines.zh: 风里有谷子的香味。
lines.en: The wind carries the smell of grain.

lines.zh: 爪子踩实了，这块地归我。
lines.en: My claws grip; this ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 火燎到羽毛，一股焦味。
lines.en: Flame catches my feathers; something smells burnt.

lines.zh: 从树枝摔下来，翅膀没接住。
lines.en: I fall from the branch; my wings fail to catch me.

lines.zh: 喷气孔进了水，我拼命上浮。
lines.en: Water in my blowhole; I fight my way upward.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，滚了好几圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; I roll several times.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的尾羽上，真难看。
lines.en: An arrow pins my tail feathers; how undignified.

lines.zh: 那股冷意钻进羽毛，我发抖。
lines.en: That cold feeling seeps through my feathers and I shiver.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连叫的力气都没。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I can't even summon a gobble.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我脖子上的毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; every feather on my neck stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我一路往下掉。
lines.en: No earth beneath me; I keep falling down.
